name: game.withdraw
description: Decides stock taken out of a storage building into the pack.

spec.title: Take stock out of storage
spec.description: Moves components and materials from a finished storage building (forge 360 V36, design depot) into the sender's pack; the target is the storage's id. Refused for more than the storage holds or than the pack has room for (components take no room).

stock.description: A name→amount map: components by count (plate, wire, solarCell, nozzle, cell, cement, lime) and ore, rock, iron, dust and minerals (ferrite, malachite, coal, …) in m³, e.g. {"plate": 10, "ferrite": 1.5}

outputs.description: A name→amount map: components by count (plate, wire, solarCell, nozzle, cell, cement, lime) and ore, rock, iron, dust and minerals (ferrite, malachite, coal, …) in m³, e.g. {"plate": 10, "ferrite": 1.5}

config.expr: let parts = ["plate", "wire", "solarCell", "nozzle", "cell", "cement", "lime"]; let top = ["ore", "rock", "iron", "dust"]; let names = type(stock) == "map" ? keys(stock) : []; let packOf = {}; let have = ship?.stock ?? {}; let vol = sum(map(filter(names, !(# in parts)), stock[#])); let held = (pack?.dust ?? 0) + (pack?.rock ?? 0) + (pack?.ore ?? 0) + (pack?.iron ?? 0) + sum(values(pack?.minerals ?? {})); !found ? "there is no storage " + target : ship.design != "depot" ? "only a storage building holds stock" : len(ship.placed) < ship.blocks ? "the storage is not finished: place its last " + string(ship.blocks - len(ship.placed)) + " blocks first" : len(names) == 0 ? "stock names what moves and how much, e.g. {\"plate\": 10}" : len(filter(names, type(stock[#]) not in ["int", "float"] || stock[#] <= 0)) > 0 ? "each amount in stock is a number above 0" : len(filter(names, (have[#] ?? 0) < stock[#] - 0.0005)) > 0 ? "the storage holds only " + join(map(sort(filter(names, (have[#] ?? 0) < stock[#] - 0.0005)), string(have[#] ?? 0) + " " + #), " and ") : held + vol > (pack?.capacity ?? 4) + 0.0001 ? "your pack has room for " + string(round(((pack?.capacity ?? 4) - held) * 100) / 100) + " m³ and this takes " + string(round(vol * 100) / 100) : ""

let parts = ["plate", "wire", "solarCell", "nozzle", "cell", "cement", "lime"]; let top = ["ore", "rock", "iron", "dust"]; let names = keys(stock); let mins = filter(names, !(# in top) && !(# in parts)); let prts = filter(names, # in parts); let tops = fromPairs(map(filter(names, # in top), [#, stock[#]])); let pk = {ore: tops?.ore ?? 0, rock: tops?.rock ?? 0, iron: tops?.iron ?? 0, dust: tops?.dust ?? 0, minerals: fromPairs(map(mins, [#, stock[#]])), parts: fromPairs(map(prts, [#, stock[#]]))}; {world: ship.world, stock: fromPairs(map(names, [#, -stock[#]])), pack: pk}

config.fix: take only what the storage holds and your pack has room for
